items.title: S. 5653 - Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 (Statement of Administration Policy)
items.summary: The Statement of Administration Policy, dated November 9, 2026, says the Administration strongly supports passage of S. 5653 and that his advisors would recommend the President sign it. The SAP does not say which text it reacts to (the September 30 bill or the November 7 substitute), and it names no requested changes in the portion read.

items.title: Trump says he backs energy permitting bill on eve of Senate vote
items.summary: President Trump posted on social media on a Sunday, which the article's Monday framing places at November 8, 2026, urging support for the permitting bill. The article does not state the post date or the platform; the post text is quoted as reported.

items.title: Senate advances sweeping energy legislation in first major action since midterm elections
items.summary: The Senate voted 73-25 on Monday, November 9, 2026 to take up the bipartisan permitting bill. The article reports that House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries's office said the bill falls short in a number of areas.

quote.text: The Senate on Monday advanced bipartisan legislation aimed at speeding up permitting reviews

events.title: President Trump posts support for the bipartisan permitting bill on social media (reported as a Sunday post)
events.summary: Per Bloomberg (published November 9), Trump's Sunday social media post called the permitting legislation landmark and said it would let pipelines, mines and power plants be built faster. The date is inferred from the Sunday reference; the article does not give it.

events.title: Senate votes 73-25 to take up the bipartisan permitting bill
events.summary: The Senate voted 73-25 on Monday, November 9, 2026 to proceed to the bipartisan permitting bill, the first major Senate action after the midterm elections, per OPB's wire-based report. The OPB article does not name H.R. 2347 in the excerpt read; the measure is the one the tracker calls the Senate floor vehicle.
